name: @vibecheck/menubar
description: Private on-device expression controls for Vibecheck

scripts.package: npm run browser:build && npm run safari:build && bash ../../scripts/verify_browser_extension.sh && electron-forge package --arch=arm64
scripts.package:local-signed: npm run browser:build && npm run safari:build && bash ../../scripts/verify_browser_extension.sh && VIBECHECK_LOCAL_SIGNING=1 electron-forge package --arch=arm64
scripts.make: npm run browser:build && npm run safari:build && bash ../../scripts/verify_browser_extension.sh && electron-forge make --arch=arm64
scripts.test:e2e: npm run browser:build && npm run safari:build && bash ../../scripts/verify_browser_extension.sh && electron-forge package --arch=arm64 && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
